value.title: Anyone creates a seat and the prime is told; suggest when unsure (workstream 007 s05)
value.summary: Any seat may add a role and spawn a seat in it; pij tells the project's prime once each time, without waking it. A seat that is unsure records a suggestion instead; the prime's view lists open ones and the prime answers each.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Any seat may add a role and spawn a seat in it; pij tells the project's prime once each time, without waking it. A seat that is unsure records a suggestion instead; the prime's view lists open ones and the prime answers each.

sections.name: goals
value: The prime knows every seat and role created in its project, and every unowned area a seat spotted.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Refusing anyone on the grounds of who is asking.

value.claim: A role added, or a seat spawned with `--as`, by a seat that is not the project's prime sends the prime one FYI (held for its next turn, waking nothing): the role, its type, the creator and the reason. A prime's own adds send nothing.
`pij directory` role rows carry `created_by` (the first changelog row's seat) and each live holder its `assigned_by`.

`pij directory suggest <area> --signal <text>` records a suggestion (`community/suggestions.json`, through the writer); it wakes no one. `pij directory suggest --answer <id> yes|no|not-yet --why <text>` records the answer. The view lists open suggestions and each answered one with its answer and reason.
The shipped prime role template (a new version) states: create the seat the work needs when you are sure, ask the operator when you are not.

value.title: Anyone creates a seat and the prime is told; suggest when unsure (workstream 007 s05)

sections.name: research_context
sections.value: FYIs to a seat: the daemon's FYI path (as plan 234 tells a prior parent). The view: community/directory.rs.

value.risk: A busy fleet sends the prime many notes.
value.mitigation: FYI: held for its next turn, never waking it.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Cost: on demand: one FYI per non-prime add or spawn; suggest and answer are one writer commit each. No loop, poll or timer.
No permission rule changes (PRD 003); no daemon enforcement of a type's rules; no existing JSON field removed or renamed.
Builds nice-19 through `just shared-build`, one at a time.
